set.descent_text: Rappel the line on its own bolted anchors. The stretch between the third and second stations is long enough to strain a single rope, so check rope length before pulling it down. A party that wants the summit instead scrambles up and right from the tree belay onto the ridge and follows Windsor Ridge to the top.

review.notes: Route page gives the rappel advice, the rope-stretch warning and the ridge scramble to the summit.

set.descent_text: The route ends at an anchor fitted with rap rings, which is how you get back down to the base of the wall.

review.notes: Route page states a rap-ring anchor; no separate descent text. Single source for the anchor.

set.descent_text: Rappel the line back down its own anchors. The pitches are long, so check rope length against each station before you commit to the descent.

review.notes: Route page says to rappel the route and that the pitches are long; one source.

set.descent_text: Rappel the route from its bolted belay stations, which carry rap rings, back to the base at the far right side of the Dune Wall.

review.notes: Route page: bolted belays with rap rings; rappel the route. One source.

set.descent_text: Rappel from the two-bolt anchor on the grassy ledge. The bolts are old and rusty, so keep as little weight on them as you can.
set.approach: From the Edith Cavell road parking lot, cross the creek and scramble up scree and small trees to the base of the wall, the big rock buttress beside Angel Glacier's right edge. Walk along the base to the orange corner of Stilgar's Corner; this line starts just to its left, up a ledge reached by a scramble of low fifth class to the first bolt.

review.notes: Area page for the approach; route page for the start and the rappel recommendation.

set.descent_text: Walk off to climber's right of the wall, or rappel from the sport and trad anchors to the base. The top anchors can be reached by scrambling up from the right end of the wall, and most lines here come down on short rappels, so watch the halfway mark on the ropes.

review.notes: Route page gives walk-off and rappel; area page adds the right-end scramble to the top anchors.

set.descent_text: The route finishes on the summit of the spire. Rappel back down the line from the bolted belays. Watch for loose blocks near the top of the corner.

review.notes: Route page: rappel advice, bolted belays, loose blocks. One source.

set.approach: Start from the Devil's Gap trailhead and follow the steep trail up to the base of the south-facing Grey Ghost Wall. Bonanza is an area classic on this wall.

review.notes: Route page and area page both give trail to the base. No descent source.

set.descent_text: After topping out the headwall, join the Lady Macdonald scramble on the summit ridge. Follow the hikers' scramble trail down to the entrance of Cougar Creek, where the route began.

review.notes: Route text gives the descent via the scramble trail to Cougar Creek.

set.descent_text: Rappel the route. Traverse back across the big ledge to reach the anchors for the first two pitches, then rappel those to the base.

review.notes: Route page descent note. One source.

set.descent_text: The route finishes on top of the Rim Wall, on the north face; the way down is the hiking trail rather than a rappel.

review.notes: Route page: hike down the trail. One source.

set.descent_text: The route ends at the top of the corner on the left side of the Rim Wall; the descent is a hike down the trail, not a rappel.

review.notes: Route page: hike down trail. One source.

set.descent_text: Rappel from the Metolius rap hangers on the route, or scramble up to the summit and follow the scramble route down. Loose rock is common on this face, so a party rappelling will knock debris onto anyone below; do not climb under another group.

review.notes: Route page descent options and rockfall warning. One source.

ab_rundle_traverse_area_rundle_traverse.skip_reason: identity in doubt: a multi-day ridge traverse over eleven summits, not a cliff line

set.descent_text: The route finishes with limestone cracks that lead to an easy walk-off, so no rappelling is needed.

review.notes: Walk-off stated by a news article; route page is only for line identity.

ab_upper_norquay_slab_calamari_crack.skip_reason: approach already rich; no descent source

set.descent_text: Rappel the route from its bolted belays back down to the base of the wall, which sits behind the roadside boulder.

review.notes: Route page gives rappel; Weeping Wall Rock area page gives the roadside parking.

set.descent_text: Rappel from the Metolius rap hangers at the top of the route.

review.notes: Route page: location, paint mark and rap hangers; Lost Boys area page: parking and trail.
